name: Ystyr Bywyd
source:
Man and his creation are searching for the meaning of life in an purposeless world. Who will be lucky enough to find the meaning in their existence? To find a purpose for which it is worth living and existing in this world.

[Translated from [url=https://anivisual.net/stuff/12-1-0-575]Anivisual[/url]]
